notes.title: Pinball FX - Steam - Patch Notes - 08.14.
notes.content:
[p]A new patch is now available for Pinball FX featuring 3 new tables, new features, optimizations, and several bug fixes. As always, thank you very much to everyone who helped us with reporting these issues![/p][p][/p][p]We have changed the combo rules on [b]Jurassic World™ Pinball [/b]in Pinball FX, as a single-shot strategy proved too easy to exploit. This change brings with it a [b]leaderboard reset [/b]to ensure new scores can compete fairly.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, let’s dive into the full list! [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Tables Added[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Williams™ Pinball Volume 9[/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3913690/Pinball_FX__Williams_Pinball_Volume_9/"][/dynamiclink][/p][list][*][p]PIN·BOT™[/p][/*][*][p]TAXI™[/p][/*][*][p]WHO dunnit™[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]New Features and Improvements[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Added questlines for Williams™ Pinball Volume 9 and Jurassic World Pinball packs.[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned the Tournament screen UI with a new filter system, a new sorting mechanism, and filter settings are now remembered.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a news screen for Questlines, explaining the powerups and the quest.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]General Fixes[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Improved audio quality for several Williams tables.[/p][/*][*][p]Weekly Leaderboard fixes applied.[/p][/*][*][p]"Adjusted score balance on the following quests to make them more achievable:[/p][p]Tomb Raider Questline - Home Sweet Home
Williams™ Pinball Volume 1 Questline - Finish Line[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed 'Collect Them All' achievement unlocking after only one event in the new season.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed broken GameMode launch flags (Classic, Pro, Challenge_BallLimited, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p]Universal Pinball: TV Classics Steam achievements no longer get mixed up.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Table Fixes[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Jurassic World™ Pinball[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where shots to the raptors’ mouth were too tight.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where spamming the left mini-flipper could trap the ball in the saucer and continuously build combos.[/p][/*][*][p]Raptor head no longer spawns on the table and blocks gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Edited combo rules so players must hit different lanes to maintain a combo, preventing abuse of a single-shot strategy. [b]This change brings with it a leaderboard reset to ensure new scores can compete fairly.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]The ball no longer goes directly to the drain from the mission starter sinkhole.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the ball could be shot straight down the middle from the Mode Start scoop if held in there long enough.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Jurassic Park Pinball Mayhem™[/b][/h3][list][*][p] Physics are no longer overly bouncy when playing offline.[/p][/*][*][p]The ball no longer moves unnaturally on the crane.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game could give unlimited balls during multiball.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Jurassic Park™ Pinball[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the score could be reduced to negative numbers after the "When dinosaurs ruled the earth" event was activated.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Tour Mode did not spawn vehicles for two players.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the ball could get stuck on Perimeter Fence step 3.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]FunHouse™[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an exploit that could cause unattained scores to appear on leaderboards; all affected duplicate and invalid scores will be removed.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Lara Croft visits the Pinball Arcades
notes.content: [p][url="https://zenstudios.com/"][u]Zen Studios[/u][/url] has been known for making digital pinball video games inspired by the biggest entertainment brands for more than a decade, mixing the features of traditional silver ball action with innovative video game elements. Our games, [b]Pinball FX[/b], [b]Pinball FX VR[/b], and[b] Zen Pinball World[/b], cover most of the gaming space with PC, Consoles, Meta Quest, and mobile. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Y4Z-6sdSMhM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]That’s why we were thrilled to announce our collaboration with [i]Tomb Raider[/i], a franchise that has defined adventure gaming for decades. Lara Croft’s blend of action, exploration, and puzzle-solving makes her the perfect fit for the world of pinball. This crossover allows us to celebrate her legacy in a new, hands-on format - one that rewards quick thinking, precision, and a spirit of discovery, just like her greatest adventures.[/p][p][/p][p]But how does a pinball table capture such a rich history as Lara Croft has? Our two new tables, [i][b]Adventures of Lara Croft[/b][/i] and [i][b]Secrets of Croft Manor[/b][/i], each highlight a different side of her story. In [i]Adventures of Lara Croft[/i], players embark on a global journey through iconic locations like Venice, Egypt, and the Great Wall of China. We’ve taken great care to recreate the details of these locations fans will instantly recognize. You’ll even wield her signature dual pistols through innovative mini-games and fast-paced multiball sequences. Every moment is designed to capture the spirit of her iconic escapades.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43901061/78eb09bba1b5efa8cc7e19e5eb2f5ca788d8b842.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Secrets of Croft Manor[/i] invites players into Lara’s ancestral home to uncover secrets and explore the roots of her legacy in a more introspective, mystery-driven experience. There’s a ton going on that will amaze Tomb Raider fans: agility courses, combat training, puzzle-solving sessions, and a maze to get lost (and found) in.[/p][p][/p][p]It can be challenging to blend such an amazing story into two pinball tables, that’s why we used dynamic interactive toys on both playfields, so players can live through these experiences and dive deep into the story.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43901061/15255b12c6bfe61cd97be1e0066bb0ed3a298c8c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Pinball may appear simple at first glance, but it’s a genre rich with depth and challenge. Behind every ramp and character is a web of strategy, timing, and precision. Our Tomb Raider tables are built to reflect this complexity, offering multiple missions and dynamic interactions that reward both new players and pinball veterans.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43901061/527e62738e0189cfae0c60490b2b54c799885c1d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’re proud to bring Lara Croft into our pinball universe in a way that honors her legacy - and challenges players to uncover every secret. Tomb Raider Pinball launches in Pinball FX on [b]June 19[/b]![/p][p][/p][h3]Wishlist [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749300?utm_source=tombraiderblog"][u]Tomb Raider Pinball[/u][/url]![/h3]

Take on the Hyakki bandit clan to avenge your fallen Master on the [b]A Samurai’s Vengeance[/b]! Train yourself in various fields to take on their leader, Maou in the final showdown. 

We created a table based on[b] Verne’s Mysterious Island[/b]! Play through the adventures of this classic novel: survive the harshest conditions, find the mysterious guardian, and escape the remote island before the smoldering lava devours it all.

[h2]Other Updates[/h2]

[b]Real DMD Support[/b]

We have worked with none other than Freezy from the Visual Pinball Community to bring this feature to Pinball FX. After the update, you can use your real DMD cabs with Pinball FX on tables that support the original dot-matrix system.

[b]New Performance Technologies[/b]

We’ve implemented performance technologies for AMD, Intel, and Nvidia, which means that you should experience improved FPS and performance on your PC after today's update.

[b]Start your favorite tables with command lines[/b]

Being able to launch your tables with command lines has been a popular request in our cabinet community. We are happy to share that this feature has been implemented into the game so now you can start your favorite tables without navigating in the main menu.

We hope that you will like these new additions to the game and wish you a fun time conquering the leaderboards!

Hey Pinball Fans!

Pinball FX is finally here! Enjoy digital pinball at its finest as the game brings you the most advanced simulation in pinball with Pro Physics for every table in the library, 4K HDR visuals, and ray tracing. [b]New tables will arrive frequently![/b]

[h2]Brand new additions[/h2]

We have more than 20 new tables coming to Steam! Dive into the shadows of the big city, explore ancient, secret tombs, and hunt for treasure on the [b]Secrets and Shadows Pack[/b], explore the mansion on [b]The Addams Family[/b], or travel to distant words, prove your honor and cunning on 3 amazing tables of the [b]Gearbox® Pinball Pack[/b]… and more!

With the Steam release of the game on April 13, five more tables will make their debut in the game. Dive into the stunning atmosphere of the [b]Godzilla vs Kong Pinball Pack[/b], everyone’s favorite [b]Twilight Zone[/b], and a table with a new concept and mechanics: [b]Crypt of the NecroDancer Pinball[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43901061/108525595113017b79630b479871a5f595720de4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Remastered Tables[/h2]

Legacy tables reloaded! In our library, every legacy table has been updated with the latest iteration of [b]Pro Physics[/b] and enhanced with [b]upgraded visuals[/b] to give you the smoothest pinball experience. Don’t worry if you can’t find your favorites in the library yet, they will come at a later date in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43901061/5c731c18b0451343b98ffe1728ed83de3badf4ce.jpg[/img]

[h2]Build your dream game room[/h2]

Build up your own customizable 3D playroom with collectible items unlocked by playing. Display your pinball mastery by achieving the unique table awards and displaying them in the PinHall!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43901061/317439690aae339ca07e004173e361e858315a8a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Events & Tournaments[/h2]

Compete with other members of the community in user-generated tournaments or official events for trophies you can display in your game room!

[h2]Cabinet Mode[/h2]

Thanks to your feedback during the Early Access period, we upgraded our cabinet mode to give you a smoother experience on your own digital cabinet!

[h2]Don’t forget to wishlist the game on the store page![/h2]
